multi_recs=[r for r in sp if len(g[r['ccity']])>1]

lines_txt="\n".join(f"{r['id']} | review={r['score']}/5 | {r['text']}" for r in multi_recs)
prompt=("Classify each order review below with exactly one label: d (delivery complaint: late, slow, lost, not received, damaged in transit), "
"p (product complaint: quality, defect, wrong size/colour, not as described, broke), s (seller service: communication, refund, cancellation, wrong or missing items), "
"g (positive/satisfied, no real complaint), o (other, vague, or price/shipping cost). "
"Output one line per record in the format: ID: label. No other text.\n\n"+lines_txt)
out=llm_query(prompt)
labels={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(O\d{5})\s*:\s*([dpsgo])', out):
    labels[m.group(1)]=m.group(2)
print(len(labels))
res=[]
for k,v in g.items():
    if len(v)<2: continue
    ds=[r['id'] for r in v if labels.get(r['id'])=='d']
    ps=[r['id'] for r in v if labels.get(r['id'])=='p']
    for a in ds:
        for b in ps:
            res.append([a,b])
print(res)
